name: Paris
headline: A side street with a point of view.
summary: A Marais 3-star, a courtyard hotel near Mouffetard, and a former textile factory in the 11th.
intro: These three Paris hotels are not a ranking and they are not a price list. Jeanne d’Arc is a 3-star the hotel itself calls economical, on a Marais side street. Henriette is a small Left Bank house with a courtyard. Fabric is a former workshop between République and Bastille that the hotel files as a 4-star. Open Booking.com for the live rate. If Lina has not checked a number, Lina does not print one.
